source.title: Modern 3 BHK House Plan | 30×40 West Facing Floor Plan Tour
source.description:
This thoughtfully planned G+1 residence on a 30×40 west-facing plot features 3 spacious bedrooms, open living spaces, ample natural light, and functional layouts perfect for modern family living.

From a practical ground floor to a private first floor and an open terrace ready for future possibilities, every detail is designed with comfort in mind.

Would you build a home like this? Let us know in the comments!

pack.topic: 30x40 Plot Structural Layout & Column Alignment Inspection
pack.source_script_insight: Translating a 30x40 plot design from drawing to ground execution requires strict verification of column grids, setbacks, and staircase headroom before laying footings.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Focusing on typical 30x40 residential plots in residential layouts like Vadavalli and Saravanampatti in Coimbatore, ensuring optimal setbacks and column orientation for urban site conditions.
pack.core_takeaway: Accurate site marking and column grid orientation on a 30x40 plot prevent expensive setback violations and dark internal spaces.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Production-grade prompt for OliveTree Builders, COIMBATORE ONLY, EXACTLY 10 SECONDS, EXACTLY 7 SCENES, PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE. 90%+ real-looking visuals, portrait 9:16 aspect ratio. Motion graphics allowed only as small subtle overlays.

SCENE 1 (0.0s - 1.4s): Real active residential construction site in Saravanampatti, Coimbatore. Eye-level shot of a civil engineer in yellow hardhat pulling a yellow steel measuring tape across a freshly surveyed 30x40 feet plot boundary on reddish soil. String lines attached to wooden pegs frame the edges. Text overlay: '30x40 Plot Plan?'. Lighting: Bright midday Tamil Nadu sun.

SCENE 2 (1.4s - 2.8s): High-angle overhead shot looking down at white lime powder being applied along stretched mason threads to mark column grid locations on dry compacted earth. Dust particles visible in daylight. Text overlay: 'Site Marking'.

SCENE 3 (2.8s - 4.2s): Over-the-shoulder medium shot. Site engineer holding a laminated 30x40 house architectural blueprint, checking distance between column marking pegs on ground. Authentic construction background with steel stirrups stacked nearby. Text overlay: 'Column Grid'.

SCENE 4 (4.2s - 5.6s): Low-angle push-in shot focusing on a yellow measuring tape held against the boundary masonry wall line to verify a 3-foot side setback gap before excavation. Ground features red soil and gravel. Text overlay: 'Setback Check'.

SCENE 5 (5.6s - 7.0s): Upward tilt shot inside a G+1 structure framing modern steel props supporting plywood staircase beam shuttering, checking 7-foot vertical headroom space. Warm ambient sunlight streaming through side cutouts. Text overlay: 'Headroom Space'.

SCENE 6 (7.0s - 8.4s): Medium side tracking shot of a skilled mason using a spirit level along red clay brick wall around a side window opening facing the set-back zone. Text overlay: 'Air Clearance'.

SCENE 7 (8.4s - 10.0s): Hero low-angle camera tilt shot showing a cleanly cast G+1 reinforced concrete frame house structure in Coimbatore, featuring straight columns, roof slab cutouts, under clear blue sky. Tiny overlay text badge: 'OliveTree Quality'.

CONTINUITY & TEXTURES: Cohesive daylight, real Coimbatore residential neighborhood surroundings, authentic red soil, steel shuttering, clay bricks, safety gear. High detail, 4k photographic quality.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No cartoon, 2D animation, flat explainer graphics, 3D floor plan architectural render look, white background infographics, glossy fake CGI, impossible camera floats, blue screen, studio setup, non-Indian workers, fake landmarks, full screen logo cards.
pack.title_english: 30x40 House Plan Construction Rules in Coimbatore
pack.caption_english: Planning to build on a 30x40 plot in Coimbatore? Executing a compact plot design requires strict ground verification before pouring concrete. Always double-check column grid alignment against your architectural floor plan to avoid structural offsets. Ensure accurate boundary setback measurements to guarantee natural lighting and cross ventilation across both floors. Pay special attention to staircase headroom height during shuttering layout. At OliveTree Builders, every site layout undergoes rigorous grid and setback checks for long-lasting structural strength. Contact us for expert residential construction in Coimbatore.
